title: [CQ-M06b] Six-workstream composition fixtures
description:
Objective: Prove that the six CQ workstreams compose: no stale-revision, check, recipe or isolation bypass at the seams between contract (F), context (C), delivery (V), isolation (R), client (I) and rollout (M). This is a SPIDR slice of [CQ-M06] (task-ced857485a1c4d75b57cc25dcc9b4d82), which keeps the docs sweep, the full regression and the whole-epic review. It depends on CQ-M05, which waits on every workstream's final task (F12, C11, V12, R13, I06), so all producers have landed when it runs.

Deliverable: packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts. It is tests only, using real tools and stores and temp Git repos, with one describe per seam:
- Stale revision (F×C×V): a requirement edit after approval advances planRevision. Plan reuse then never resumes the row, the recipe instance reads stale, and strict entry or completion is refused PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED. A review, candidate or check run bound to the old revision is refused, or does not satisfy delivery.
- Check (V×C×M): under a strict deliveryPolicy, each of these is refused at delivery, identically under legacy and observe: a missing, failing or inconclusive required check; a caller-labelled runner observation; a candidate that edits a protected check config or the recipe definitions.
- Recipe (C×F×M): an ineligible or mismatched instantiation falls back to ordinary planning with no approval stamp, and 'moe-recipe' impersonation is refused.
- Isolation (R×M×V×I): verified-local is refused on every path (settings activation through the CQ-M05 control, claim, completion, delivery) with no host fallback. Nothing records isolation, readiness or verifiedLocal from a legacy or observe runner, check or client.
Every refusal asserts the exact codeName and that nothing was written. Legacy control rows keep their compatibility outcomes.

Not in scope:
- New production behavior. A defect fix over about 30 lines, or any contract change, goes to its owning task through moe.report_blocked.
- IDE rendering (I06), real VM provisioning (R13) and docs.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts covers the stale-revision, check, recipe and isolation seams named in the description, each through real tools with exact codeName assertions.
Every refusal case also proves nothing was written: task, attempt, candidate, check, review and receipt bytes are unchanged.
No gate is mocked, no test-only certification is used, and verified-local is never made ready.
Legacy-profile control rows keep their existing compatibility outcomes in the same scenarios.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Create packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts: the shared fixture plus seams A and C.

Fixture:
- ToolTestHarness and a real temp Git repo. Copy git() and commit() from delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts: GIT_* masked, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL set, fixed identities, no Git mocks.
- MOE_* seat env stubbed to ''.
- bytes(): a path-to-bytes map of every file under .moe/{tasks,attempts,candidates,checks,reviews,receipts}, over whichever directories exist, used for the no-write proofs.
- refused(call, codeName): asserts the codeName and that bytes() is unchanged.
- Profiles are set only through h.state.updateSettings. A strict cutover is the in-memory hand edit F12 uses; nothing ever makes verified-local ready (no readiness spy, no test-only certification).
- Every expectation is exact: toEqual or toBe, never truthiness.

Seam A, stale revision (F×C×V), with deliveryPolicy 'local-branch' and approvalMode CONTROL. Submit a plan whose executionContract.requiredChecks protects a committed config, approve revision 1, claim, serve, and record candidate C1 at revision 1 with a passing authenticated check run. Then edit the definitionOfDone, which advances planRevision to 2.
- A1: under the strict cutover, start_step and complete_task with the current identity are refused PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED (no write).
- A2: qa_approve naming C1 is refused (V06's landed code: the stale revision or candidate mismatch). evaluateDeliveryEvidence no longer counts C1's check run toward revision 2: assert its exact missingEvidence token.
- A3: after request_replan (PLANNING, with approved revision 1 != planRevision 2), plan reuse never resumes the row: an architect claim returns it (planner path) and planReuse is not reuse/refresh. A recipe-born plan's readRecipeInstance(task) reads null once the revision advances.
- Legacy control: the same edit under legacy with no strict cutover keeps the compatibility path. Steps start without identity, and only delivery evidence is re-judged.

Seam C, recipe (C×F×M), approvalMode CONTROL, table over ['legacy','observe']:
- C1: an ineligible C09 instantiation, and C2 a mismatched one (hash mismatch, old text missing or ambiguous), each return {instantiated:false, fallback:'ordinary-planning', reason:<exact>}. The row stays byte-identical: no plan, no recipeInstance, no approval stamp.
- C3: an eligible instantiation lands AWAITING_APPROVAL with no approvedPlanRevision.
- C4: moe.submit_plan with workerId 'moe-recipe' and no internal channel is refused NOT_ALLOWED with no write.
- C5: after a definitionOfDone edit, approving the recipe plan with the stale expectedPlanRevision (state.approveTask) is refused PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH with no write.
Outcomes must be identical across the two profiles, ids and timestamps aside.

Error handling: if a seam exposes a real defect, make the smallest fix (at most ~30 lines) in the owning module, after moe.declare_files on it, and keep the case as its regression. A larger fix or a contract change gets report_blocked naming the owning task. Never weaken or skip a case. Run `npx vitest run src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts`.

Add seams B and D to __e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts (created in step 2; extend it in place, ~150 more lines).

Seam B, check (V×C×M), deliveryPolicy 'local-branch', table over ['legacy','observe']. A REVIEW row with candidate C on the approved revision. Each case is refused at qa_approve with the landed delivery refusal codeName and its exact missingEvidence or token, and bytes() is unchanged (no review written):
- B1: no check run.
- B2: a check run with each non-passing outcome: code-failure, infra-failure, timeout, skipped, inconclusive.
- B3: a moe.record_check_run call that self-labels source 'runner-observed' without the runner channel. It is not authenticated and never counts.
- B4: a candidate whose tree changes a protected config, giving `protected-check-changed:<path>`.
- B5: a recipe task whose candidate edits .moe/recipes.json, giving `protected-check-changed:.moe/recipes.json`. Build it in the temp repo only; never touch the real .moe.
- Control: a passing authenticated run on the unchanged candidate approves, identically under both profiles.

Seam D, isolation (R×M×V×I):
- D1: one row is strict through a stored verified-local task snapshot, seeded raw as the only way in. In sequence, each of these is refused EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY and bytes() is unchanged:
  - updateSettings({executionProfile:'verified-local'}), with CQ-M05's refused record written;
  - an explicit claim;
  - complete_task for an attempt opened with a verified-local snapshot, after a rollback to legacy;
  - qa_approve.
  The stored profile is never silently changed: no host fallback.
- D2: after the B-control run (legacy or observe, authenticated runner), walk every JSON record under .moe (tasks, attempts, candidates, checks, reviews, receipts). No key matching /verified|isolat|ready|trust|certif/i holds a truthy value, except keys that already existed on the fixture rows: compare key sets before and after. decodeClientHello({protocolVersion:1, capabilities:{verifiedLocal:true, runnerStatus:true, modelReceipts:true}}) negotiates all three false.

The same fix-forward rule as step 2 applies. Run the file again with `npx vitest run src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts`.

One adversarial self-review of this task's diff (load adversarial-self-review). Check:
- Each scenario truly crosses its workstreams, rather than re-testing one producer.
- No gate is mocked, no readiness spy is used, and no test-only certification exists.
- The strict cutover is only ever the in-memory hand edit, and is restored per test.
- The no-write proofs cover every evidence directory that exists.
- The legacy control rows keep their compatibility outcomes.
- Temp Git repos are isolated from the real repo: GIT_* masked, cwd set, cleanup on failure.
- Flaky timing: SPEED is never used; reuse jobs are awaited with settlePlanReuseAssessments.
- No real .moe edits, no Git writes, and no peer bytes touched.
- Error handling: a refused call leaves every store unchanged, and a failing fixture setup throws a named error instead of passing vacuously.
List any fix-forward edits with their owning tasks in the step note.

acceptanceCriteria: Seam cases A1-A3, B1-B5, C1-C5 and D1-D2 pass, each with an exact codeName/token and a no-write proof for every refusal.
Each production mutant in step 4 turns its named case red in a scratch copy.
invariants: Tests only. Any production fix is at most ~30 lines in its owning module, declared and regression-tested; anything larger is report_blocked.
No mocked gate, readiness spy or test-only certification, and verified-local is never made ready.
No real .moe edits or Git writes.
sourceAssumptions: Landed: delivery/requiredChecks.ts (V01), delivery/policy.ts evaluateDeliveryEvidence and the protected-check-changed tokens, state/candidateStore.ts, state/checkRunStore.ts (CHECK_OUTCOMES), context/planReuse*.ts (C07), server/clientCapabilities.ts, __e2e__/executionContract.e2e.test.ts helpers.

Assumed, landing before M05 is DONE: the C08 recipe entry and RECIPE_ACTOR, the C09 kind, the V03/V03b runner observations, V04's passing-run predicate, V06's review binding, V12a's bypass fixtures, and CQ-M05's profileRollout and attempt-level readiness. Adapt to the landed names.

planningNotes.risks:
- Many producers land after this plan: read every landed name first (step 1), never stub one, and report_blocked any that is missing.
- Brittle exact tokens: read them from the landed code.
- Temp Git repo hygiene (GIT_* masked).
- The full suite runs only in a Linux snapshot.
- Size is about 350 test lines, plan-mandated.
- Avoid flaky waits: settle plan-reuse jobs explicitly and never use SPEED timers.
